item.title: Nigeria and UAE strike sweeping trade deal
item.description: Nigeria is strengthening economic ties with the United Arab Emirates through a sweeping trade agreement designed to boost commerce and attract fresh investment. item.title: Kenya inks preliminary trade deal with China
item.description: Kenya is moving to rebalance its trade relationship with China after securing a preliminary agreement that grants duty-free access for 98.2% of its exports. Announced by the trade ministry, the deal marks a significant step toward a broader bilateral trade pact now under discussion. item.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea’s rift deepens
item.description: Tensions between Ethiopia and Eritrea have flared again after Ethiopian police accused Asmara of secretly supplying ammunition to rebels in the Amhara region. Authorities say they seized 56,000 rounds of ammunition and arrested suspects allegedly linked to Eritrea’s ruling party, a claim Eritrea has firmly denied. item.title: The “equity pricing” model shaking up African nightlife
item.description: A pioneering South African DJ named Desiree is reshaping club culture with her MMiNO event series through an intentional practice called equity pricing. When purchasing tickets, international guests pay a higher rate than local attendees.
